Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting our SIG/CAIQ + SOC 2 review for internal procurement and would like to kick off an intake call next week to review scope, evidence cadence, and access windows. High level:
- We're mainly concerned about data residency and log exports.
- We have a short deadline: procurement needs sign-off by end of June.

Do you have availability for a 60-min kickoff on Wed/Thu next week (May 26/27)? If not, any time the following week also works. We'll want to invite our InfoSec lead (Emma) and the cloud ops engineer that will help with log exports.

Thanks,

Connor,

Thanks for the options. Wed May 26 14:00 PDT works best for our team — I've blocked it. A few clarifications ahead of the call:
- Cloud provider: GCP (us-west1). We can grant a temporary IAM role for read-only access to logs if needed, but we'd prefer a pull-model where Redwood provides a sanitized sample unless it's strictly necessary for you to access raw logs.
- Data residency: we need confirmation that customer data for our account will remain in us-west1 and not be replicated outside the US without explicit consent.
- Retention windows: we want a clear mapping of which logs are retained for 30/90/365 days.

Also attaching our internal asset inventory; I'll hand this to our cloud ops contact during the call.

Subject: Re: SIG intake & kickoff - Astrolune (CAIQ + SOC 2) — Call notes & action grid

Thanks for the kickoff today — summary and next steps below. Please reply if I missed anything.

Call summary (60 min) — 2027-05-26 14:00 PDT
- Attendees: Rajiv Menon (Astrolune), Emma Lin (Astrolune), Connor O'Brien (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Irene Choi (Redwood), Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Scope: CAIQ baseline + SOC 2 artifact mapping for Redwood-hosted inference for Astrolune account; focus on logging, data residency, key management, and access controls.
- Key clarifications:
  - Data residency: Redwood confirmed customer data storage region policy — primary data for the Astrolune account provisioned in us-west1 and not automatically replicated outside the US; cross-region replication requires explicit customer opt-in. (Irene to provide reference doc.)
  - Log exports: Astrolune prefers sanitized samples. Redwood will provide a 24-hour sample export showing request/response headers, anonymized user identifiers, and token-level latency metrics.
  - Retention: Platform default: request logs 30 days, audit logs 365 days; configurable per-account. (Ben to capture config steps.)
  - Encryption and KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations; Marissa to provide the KMS onboarding checklist.

Action grid (owners & deadlines):
- Connor: upload the filled CAIQ template (ASTROLUNE_CAIC_MATRIX_v1.xlsx) with preliminary answers + mark items that need vendor evidence — due 2027-05-28.
- Marissa: share KMS onboarding checklist and SOC 2 artifact index; schedule a follow-up 30-min handoff with Astrolune cloud ops — due 2027-05-30.
- Ben: provide step-by-step guide to enabling per-account log retention and export; include CLI/API example for granting temporary read-only access to a GCP service account — due 2027-05-31.
- Irene: link to our docs on data residency and replication policy (internal doc) — due 2027-05-27.
- Rajiv/Emma (Astrolune): confirm whether they will grant temporary read-only IAM for log pulls or prefer Redwood to upload sanitized samples to their secure share — decision due 2027-05-24.

Attachments delivered: ASTROLUNE_CAIC_MATRIX_v1.xlsx (filled with initial answers, placeholder items flagged), access_instructions.pdf (short guide for creating temporary read-only IAM for Redwood)

Notes / Risks:
- Timeline: procurement sign-off target end of June — need prompt evidence handoffs to avoid delay.
- Sensitive logs: upstream redaction of PII must be validated; Redwood sample will include anonymization steps and a small verification script.

Next meeting: 30-min technical handoff (Marissa to schedule) — target week of 2027-05-31.

Connor O'Brien
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
